reason: My Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp already bring guests in and cost me nothing. I'm not putting my guests' payments and contacts on a brand-new startup's platform. Maybe I'd take the free listing, but I wouldn't pay 59 a month.
objection: If they shut down in a year, my guest list and reviews go with them. And who owns that data? It's not clear if they could sell it or use it to push my regulars toward other restaurants in their diner app.
would_change_my_mind: A written promise that the guest data is mine and I can export it any time, and a couple of restaurant owners I know in Tbilisi using it for months and telling me it brought people back.
